name: Porsås - Nornäs
description: Porsås to Nornäs. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: WST lists 7 km; Naturkartan lists 6.9 km; official tour suggestion reportedly says day/stage 22 is 8 km.
Stage 21 official GPX ends near Holmen and leaves a 4.296 km straight-line gap to Stage 22 start, while official Stage 21 metadata says Flötemarksön-Porsås 14 km.
WST says Loviseholm is a bus stop about 2 km east of Porsås, served from Ed, but current Västtrafik stop-area data did not show a fixed stop named Loviseholm.
Swedish WST includes the Nornäs private-road/Norane parking warning, while English WST omits it and has machine-translation artifacts.
Nearby Bohusleden context includes Kynne älv, Kynnefjäll, Bredmossen and Noraneälven, but Stage 22 official GPX itself did not show a direct protected-area/water-protection intersection in this pass.
Nornäs has shelter, dry toilet, trash/swimming/lake context and field reports mention lake water, but no official source calls it potable drinking water.

facilities.name: Informationstavla Porsås
facilities.description: Trail information board at the Porsås / Stage 22 start area, close to road 164 and the official GPX start. Use as Stage 22 start-area facility and Stage 21 intended-destination context, not as proof that Stage 21 official GPX reaches Porsås.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Porsås
facilities.description: Small Porsås parking/access area near Stage 22 start. WST/facility lane says capacity is about 2-3 cars; OSM says access=permissive and capacity=3. Small capacity only. Not a public transport stop.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Nornäs / Nornäs shelter cluster
facilities.description: Nornäs endpoint shelter cluster by Lake Kornsjön/Mellan-Kornsjön with wind shelter, fire place, dry toilet, information/map context, waste/trash context and swimming/waterfront. Stage 23 page corroborates shelter, swimming and toilet. Tanum installed a new toilet in November 2024 according to the facilities lane. Cluster/de-duplicate OSM shelter, toilet, firepit, waste and map nodes before runtime import. No official drinking-water claim was found; do not create a potable-water POI.
